name: How long does it typically take to install new interior window trim?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to install new interior window trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for new interior window trim varies depending on the number of windows, the complexity of the trim style, and whether old trim needs to be removed. For a standard home with an average number of windows, installation can often be completed within one to three days. More intricate designs or a larger number of windows will naturally extend this timeline. During our consultation, we provide a more precise estimate based on your specific project scope in areas like Meridian or Eagle.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for interior window trim typically ranges from one to three days, depending on the number of windows and trim complexity.
